authority: Same-context analysis. Not independent review. Grants no scientific or promotion authority.
object: The headline QUESTION of Paper II, not its answers.
qoi: Which question maximizes (a) receipt support on main, (b) sign-robustness, (c) field need, (d) ledger consistency - given the executed external-corpus negative that must never be re-read positively.

current_question.statement: When may experience recorded in one problem fibre move into another? Terminal state: specification + adapted typed refusal + instrument-falsifiability methods + an executed honest negative (NEGATIVE__CAPABILITY_ABSENT on ARN: witness advantage -0.016, CI [-0.0498, +0.0162], retention 0.023 at false-accept 0.044).
current_question.character: The abstract already relocates the open question from label availability to a measured extraction-capability gap and names the successor: a capable learned reducer entering through the same admission gate with contamination accounting.

candidate_questions.question: When may experience transfer between fibres? (incumbent specification question)
candidate_questions.receipt_support: STRONG for the specification itself; but as a headline it is heavily occupied.
candidate_questions.field_need: The in-repo novelty audit (research/paper2_nearest_work_2026/NOVELTY_THREAT_RANKING.md) marks causal transportability (Bareinboim-Pearl sID) as a RED threat occupying most conjuncts; exactly four residuals survive (returned third verdict, licensed cross-vocabulary role correspondence, non-causal artifacts without a selection diagram, forbidden-loss enumeration). The paper already concedes this positioning.
candidate_questions.ledger_consistency: Ledger row MECH-TRANSPORT-APPLICABILITY-CONTRACT: benefit CIRCULAR, outcome SELF_AUTHORED for the six-family gate - the strongest surviving claim is a SPECIFICATION claim.

candidate_questions.question: What is the measured reducer-capability frontier at which structural transfer begins to pay, under a fail-closed admission gate? (boundary-measurement reframe of the negative)
candidate_questions.receipt_support: STRONG substrate: frozen battery-validated instrument (the ARN run's B2-B5 all passed, making the negative a MEASUREMENT, not an apparatus artifact - the first in the transfer line); vendored sha-pinned corpus (research/paper2_external_corpus_v1/data/arn.csv); admission gate is shipped code (admit_reducer, src/rakl/reduction_validation.py: scramble-sensitivity, obstruction harvest, external-label author independence). The executed negative anchors the frontier's zero point: the registered deterministic reducer is at chance (witness exact 0.490).
candidate_questions.sign_robustness: SIGN-ROBUST by construction: a monotone reducer-capability staircase (deterministic -> syntactic-role -> small learned -> larger learned), each admitted through the same gate and evaluated on the SAME frozen confirmatory pairs, reports a capability-vs-retention frontier. Every staircase step lands ON the frontier wherever it lands; an all-negative staircase extends the measured boundary ('no admissible reducer up to capability X recovers system structure from natural prose'), which is itself the publishable result.
candidate_questions.field_need: Cross-domain analogy corpora exist (ARN GREEN-verified; StoryAnalogy reserve with graded 0-3 relation-similarity ratings, SEARCH_LEDGER.md), but a capability-conditioned transfer frontier over a fail-closed admission gate is not claimed by any in-repo-verified nearest work; beyond the verified GREEN list this is CANNOT_CHECK - route to nearest-work lane.
candidate_questions.ledger_consistency: Converts the ledger's CIRCULAR/SELF_AUTHORED row into an externally-labelled measurement line (ARN labels are third-party). Non-compensatory: capability, retention and false-accept are reported as a vector, never fused.

candidate_questions.question: Is the residual capability gap extraction-side or metric-side? (stage attribution)
candidate_questions.receipt_support: PARTIAL. ARN ships no per-narrative gold structures (vendored CSV columns: id, proverb, query_narrative, first_choice, second_choice, distractor_similarity, analogy_level, correct_answer), so the gold-structure factorization is not runnable on ARN. A planted-structure known-answer world CAN separate metric validity from extraction mechanically - see the metric open-problem protocol in this audit directory.
candidate_questions.sign_robustness: Robust: either attribution outcome (metric refuted independent of extraction / extraction confirmed as the sole bottleneck) is informative and reopens a different fiber.
candidate_questions.field_need: Programme-internal but load-bearing: it is the discriminator between 'build a better reducer' and 'build a better metric'.
candidate_questions.ledger_consistency: Consistent; matches the root-cause rule (attribute failure to ONE stage before applying a lever).

candidate_questions.question: Does witness-gated transfer beat ungated transfer on natural corpora? (victory question - REJECTED for now)
candidate_questions.receipt_support: BLOCKED: the executed negative shows any such run through the current admissible reducer re-measures the reducer, not the gate.
candidate_questions.field_need: High demand; unanswerable honestly until a capable reducer clears admission.
candidate_questions.ledger_consistency: Running it now would recreate the structural trap (outcome dominated by a known instrument limitation).

candidate_questions.question: What must a transfer benchmark satisfy for its gate to be falsifiable? (methods extension)
candidate_questions.receipt_support: STRONG: the falsifiability battery and its distilled design requirements are already in the paper, evidenced by the programme's own preserved negatives (non-falsifiable six-family gate; serialization-fidelity instrument; template-inversion terminal).
candidate_questions.sign_robustness: Robust; applying the battery to external benchmarks yields findings either way.
candidate_questions.field_need: Real (benchmark-quality critique is an active field need) but this is already claimed territory in the current manuscript; the marginal question is the external application.

recommended_headline_question.statement: What capability must a reducer have for structural transfer to pay? Measure the frontier, not the victory: retention/false-accept as a function of admitted reducer capability on the same frozen third-party-labelled pairs.
recommended_headline_question.selection_basis: Non-compensatory: PII-Q2 is the only candidate that converts existing receipts (battery-passed instrument + executed negative + vendored corpus + shipped admission gate) into a forward question that is publishable under every outcome. It subsumes the abstract's named successor epoch and de-risks it: a SINGLE successor reducer is sign-risky (it may simply fail again); a staircase is a frontier measurement.

concrete_evidence_delta.name: reducer-capability staircase on the frozen ARN confirmatory set
design: Freeze a capability ladder before any arm runs: R0 = registered deterministic reducer (executed; frontier zero-point, never re-run as new evidence), R1 = syntactic-role reducer (dependency-parse roles, still deterministic), R2 = small learned extractor, R3 = stronger learned extractor. Each enters through admit_reducer (scramble-sensitivity, obstruction harvest, external-label author independence) plus a mandatory contamination declaration (ARN public since 2023-10; any pretrained component must declare exposure).

Same frozen confirmatory pairs, same battery (B2 text destruction, B3 shuffled gold, B4 trivial floor, B5 paired variance), same G1/G2/G3 endpoints as research/paper2_external_corpus_v1/PROTOCOL.json; per-rung typed outcome.
Report: the (capability, retention, false-accept, advantage CI) frontier as a table; no scalar 'best reducer' ranking.
Ownership note: paper2 lanes (paper2-frontier / paper2-instrument) own execution; this audit contributes the sign-robust framing and the frozen-staircase requirement.
concrete_evidence_delta.runnability: R1 is CPU-feasible on laptop billy. R2/R3 require model inference - resource-gated; honest status: CANNOT_CHECK until the lanes schedule capacity. Nothing in this audit executes any arm.
concrete_evidence_delta.chronology_rule: The ladder definition and per-rung admission criteria must be frozen before any rung's result is observed; a rung added after seeing results is a new versioned staircase.
concrete_evidence_delta.representation_tournament_link: Per operator addendum 2026-08-14: whether the CONTRACT'S REPRESENTATION is right is a separate tournament question - REPRESENTATION_TOURNAMENT_PROTOCOL_V1.json Contest 2 (exact shape-signature vs graded metric) is registered design-only and shares this staircase's reducer blocker; the admissible capable reducer is the programme's single highest-leverage shared blocker (it unlocks the Paper II staircase, metric Stage B, and Contest 2 simultaneously).

must_not_be_claimed: The executed ARN negative must never be re-read positively or re-run as if new; it is the frontier's zero point and immutable negative history.
'Capability absent' remains scoped to registered reducers in this programme - never 'no reducer can do this'.
Admission of a learned reducer does not license any transfer claim by itself; retention/false-accept must clear the frozen gates on the frozen pairs.
No cross-domain generality claim from ARN alone (single corpus, narrative domain, binary labels).
A fused reducer-quality score is forbidden; capability/retention/false-accept stay a vector (no-scalarization consistency).
